title: Hymns for Organ & Piano
subtitle: Two instruments, two players
blurb: The organ plays each hymn as it stands in the hymnal, with pedals; the piano adds the tune in octaves over flowing broken chords. Hymnal keys are kept. In the facing-pages edition the organ part is on the left-hand pages and the piano part on the right.
